messages.subject: Details on the CalMaTe method
parts:
Hi everyone,

I recently tried the CalMate add-on to improve the copy number and
allelic frequency estimates, and it really does bring a nice
improvement, especially on the allelic frequency (the different levels
of allelic frequency are clearly more distinguishable). However, I
searched the aroma-project website but could find no documentation on
the algorithm by itself, only a reference to a non-submitted paper in
the addons page (CalMaTe - A calibration method to improve allele-
specific copy number estimates from SNP microarrays, 2010 (to be
submitted) ). Is it possible to have technical details on the CalMaTe
calibration method ?

Thank you in advance,
Jonas Mandel
